newsitem.title: USA: Blyth says invests US$810,000 in Colony Gift.
newsitem.headline: Blyth says invests US$810,000 in Colony Gift.

text.p: Blyth Industries Inc said Friday it has invested the equivalent $810,000 U.S. dollars, in Colony Gift Corp Ltd, a British manufacturer of candles in which it has a 50 percent equity interest.
The company said the funds will be used by Colony Gift to buy a majority interest in Fragrant Memories Ltd, a home fragrance company headquarted on the Isle of Wight.
Blyth said its equity position will not increase as a result of this transaction, although it has options to buy 100 percent of Colony Gift.
